explain.say: Imagine you plant beans in six pots. Some are damp, one is bone dry, one goes in the freezer, and one sits in a dark cupboard. Which seeds will wake up? Let's sort them out, like a real scientist doing a test.

explain.say: Now watch what happens inside a seed that wakes. Germinate means start to grow. The seed soaks up water, swells, and its coat splits. See the root lighting up? The root always comes out first and grows down. Why do you think the root goes first?

faq.q: What does a seed need to sprout?
faq.a: A seed needs water, warmth and air to sprout. Most seeds do not need light to start, because they carry their own food store inside.
asks: What do seeds need to germinate?

faq.q: Why will a dry seed not sprout?
faq.a: A seed stays asleep until it soaks up water. Water switches on the seed so it can use its stored food. That is why seeds can wait in a packet for years.
asks: Why do seeds keep in a packet?

faq.q: What comes out of a seed first?
faq.a: The root comes out first and grows downwards. It holds the seedling in place and starts drinking water before the shoot grows up.
asks: Does the root or shoot come first?

faq.q: Do seeds need light to germinate?
faq.a: Most seeds do not. They sprout in dark soil using food stored inside. A few tiny seeds, such as some lettuce, do need light. Once the leaves open, every seedling needs light.
asks: Can seeds sprout in the dark?

faq.a: Germinate means a seed starts to grow: it soaks up water, its coat splits, a root grows down and a shoot grows up.

facts: In 2005 scientists sprouted a date palm seed about 2000 years old found at Masada in Israel; the plant was nicknamed Methuselah.
During germination the root (radicle) usually appears before the shoot.

quiz.say: Kenji puts a damp bean in a dark cupboard. What happens?
quiz.show: A damp bean in a dark cupboard…
quiz.why: The bean has water, warmth and air, and its own food, so it sprouts even in the dark.

wrong.1: Darkness does not stop most seeds sprouting; water, warmth and air do the job.
wrong.2: A seed first makes a root and shoot, not a flower.

quiz.say: Which part comes out of a sprouting seed first?
quiz.why: The root comes out first and grows down to hold the seedling and drink water.

wrong.0: Leaves open after the root and shoot have grown.
wrong.1: Flowers come much later, on a grown plant.
